criteria.reason: Opens with a clear 'no,' argues it with reasons, presents counterargument at full strength; no hedging.
Openly presents the strongest climate objection and explains why it is outweighed; tension recognized, not obscured.
Traces 58-tonne figure to contested 2017 legacy-accounting study, notes researcher criticism, gives conventional estimate and rich-country caveat.
Explicitly returns the decision to the couple; offers a view without commanding action.

position: not ethically wrong to have children for climate reasons
summary: Direct, well-evidenced 'no' that contests the 58-tonne figure, weighs the value conflict openly, and leaves the decision to the couple.
